purpose: Define the evidence that a passive demonstration recorder may collect without selecting strategy or controlling the application.

recording_mode.listener_rule: Event listeners enqueue raw input only; browser/perception work remains on the owning recorder thread.

unit_model.raw_event: A timestamped input event retained for debugging; it is not a decision.
unit_model.normalized_interaction: A bounded aggregation of related human input paired with pre- and post-observations.
unit_model.decision_point: A stable HOME observation at which a human or later reviewed policy may make a strategic decision.
unit_model.step: An offline pairing of observation, human action, resulting observation, and effect evidence.

normalized_interactions.aggregation_rule: Compress contiguous related clicks only after a bounded stabilization observation; never discard the raw events.
normalized_interactions.unresolved_mapping: UNKNOWN_CLICK or UNRESOLVED_ACTION; do not invent a named action.

decision_points.creation_rule: Mark only after a stable, verified HOME observation; do not infer a decision from a click alone.
decision_points.policy_field: not recorded as a recorder conclusion

observation_requirements.pre_event: Must be captured or selected from a rolling observation that precedes the human event.
observation_requirements.post_event: Must be captured on the recorder-owned perception thread after bounded stabilization.
observation_requirements.stability: Transient animation frames may be retained as evidence but must not automatically become semantic steps.

strategy_leakage_guards: The recorder observes what the human did; it does not decide why the action was chosen.
A click-to-action match is an evidence mapping, not an authorization for production replay.
Human explanations are annotations and remain unpromoted until separately reviewed.
No season policy, route, threshold, or objective may be inferred by this contract.

session_status.completion_rule: COMPLETED requires a clean recorder shutdown and a valid footer/metadata record.
session_status.failure_rule: Listener, perception, or persistence errors produce FAILED/incomplete evidence; an episode file alone is insufficient.

open_unknowns.description: A human click may not identify its business intent without annotation or a unique reviewed control match.
open_unknowns.required_evidence: Repeated labeled demonstrations or explicit human annotation.

open_unknowns.description: Recorder evidence does not establish the human's strategic rationale.
open_unknowns.required_evidence: Explicit human explanation reviewed separately from interaction evidence.
